instances.claim: This tells me that there is a defined body of works called Cents, with a fixed membership, each member of which has the same five-stage life.
instances.why: Line 8 quantifies over a collection — 'Every Cent' — that the draft has never bounded: lines 1–7 give one artwork (Brenner's Lincoln) and one singular readymade ('the readymade Rutherford Chang chose'), which is a kind of object, not a counted set of works. Because 'every' plus the five enumerated events in 9–13 is a claim about a population, the lines that follow inherit a membership the piece never established.
